mcdt.config.title: Minecraft DevTools Settings
mcdt.config.restart_required: §eRequires a game restart to take effect.
mcdt.config.category.server.desc: Where the local REST/WebSocket API listens.
mcdt.config.category.security.desc: What API clients are allowed to do.
mcdt.config.enabled.desc: Start the local HTTP server at all.
mcdt.config.preferredPort.desc: Port to try first. A random free port is used if it is taken. The MCDT_PORT environment variable overrides this.
mcdt.config.bindAddress.desc: Address the server binds to. Keep 127.0.0.1 so only this machine can connect.
mcdt.config.bindAddress.warning: §cAnything other than a loopback address exposes the API to your network.
mcdt.config.permission.desc: Highest permission granted to API clients. Read: game state. Act: input, chat, options, screen actions. Reflect-write: field set, method invoke, raw packets.
mcdt.config.permission.warning: §cReflect-write lets API clients run arbitrary code paths in your game.
mcdt.config.allowQuit.desc: Whether the two-step quit endpoints may shut the game down.
mcdt.config.originAllowlist.desc: Extra browser origins allowed to call the API, e.g. http://localhost:5173.
mcdt.config.allowedMultiplayerServers.de: Server addresses where act and reflect-write actions are permitted.
mcdt.config.requestTimeoutMs.desc: How long a request waits for the client thread before failing with 504.
mcdt.config.tickBudgetMicros.desc: Time the client thread may spend on queued API tasks per tick.
mcdt.config.eventSubscriberQueueCapacity: Outgoing event queue size for each new WebSocket subscriber. Existing connections keep their size.
mcdt.config.queueCapacity.desc: Maximum queued tasks before the API answers 503.
mcdt.config.eventRingBufferSize.desc: Capacity of the lock-free event ring buffer.
mcdt.config.enableMcp.desc: Serve the Model Context Protocol endpoint at /mcp.
mcdt.config.mcpLogCalls.desc: Keep recent MCP tool calls in an in-memory log.
mcdt.config.enableBaritone.desc: Expose Baritone pathing endpoints and tools when Baritone is installed.
mcdt.config.mcpNotificationThrottleMs.de: Minimum time between resource update notifications per URI per session.
